IMPORTANT_task_scope: BLME's geometry_lipschitz (src/blme/tasks/geometry/lipschitz.py) does NOT implement a spectral-norm / power-iteration sigma_max kernel and does NOT form an AutoLip product of per-layer spectral norms. It computes the hidden-state RELATIVE-CHANGE ratio ||h_{l+1}(x) - h_l(x)|| / ||h_l(x)|| across adjacent layers, and is already labelled 'proxy-only' in task_metadata.py and in its own docstring (lines 37-40, 112-115). The Virmaux&Scaman/Miyato citations describe the sigma_max KERNEL, which in BLME lives in weight_norms.py and spectral.py (exact SVD), not in lipschitz.py.
blme_sigma_max_kernel: spectral norm = largest singular value via EXACT SVD: torch.linalg.svdvals(W)[0]. This is NOT power iteration; it is exact, so it is bit-parity with numpy.linalg.norm(W,2) / scipy.linalg.svdvals(W)[0].
reference_sigma_max: max_eigenvalue._power_method_matrix (power iteration on W^T W) and max_eigenvalue.generic_power_method (power iteration on a linear layer). Both estimate sigma_max(W).
reference_autolip_product: lipschitz_approximations.lipschitz_spectral_ub (lines 275-309): product over layers of generic_power_method(layer). This is the AutoLip UPPER BOUND.

blme_svd_vs_exact.note: BLME's torch.linalg.svdvals(W)[0] == exact numpy/scipy sigma_max to float64 eps.

reference_power_iteration_vs_exact.note: lipEstimation power iteration runs in float32 (its own dtype contract) and converges to exact sigma_max to ~7e-8 relative given enough iterations. Both _power_method_matrix and generic_power_method agree.

autolip_product.label: AutoLip UPPER BOUND (product of per-layer sigma_max) — NOT the true / tighter SeqLip network Lipschitz constant.

verdict.global_lipschitz: PROXY / AutoLip UPPER BOUND (not the true SeqLip network Lipschitz constant)
verdict.geometry_lipschitz_task: hidden-state relative-change ratio ||dh||/||h|| — a separate PROXY that does NOT use the sigma_max kernel; already labelled proxy-only.
verdict.summary: The spectral-norm sigma_max KERNEL is PARITY (BLME exact SVD == numpy.linalg.norm(W,2); lipEstimation power iteration converges to the same to ~7e-8 rel). The GLOBAL AutoLip product-of-sigma_max is an honest documented UPPER BOUND (PROXY), not the tight network Lipschitz constant. The geometry_lipschitz task ships a different hidden-state relative-change proxy entirely.
